text:
sara: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered rollout for Orbit-9B into the model catalog TOMORROW 10:00 PST. Goal: pin v1.2.0 variant for hosted + dedicated. Who can own the deploy window and smoke checks?

ezra: I can own infra side for the 10:00 canary -> 10:20 full. Will run autoscaler sanity and GPU health. @sara please add me to the runbook. :+1:

marta: I can do ML validation (quality checks + embedding drift). I’ll bring the eval set and scripts.

kevin: I’ll coordinate the catalog API pin and rollout policy. Can we do a stagger: 10:00 canary (10% traffic), 10:20 50%, 10:40 100%?

sara: Yes to that schedule. Canary 10% at 10:00, monitor 20m, then 50% at 10:20 if smoke OK, final cutover 10:40.

lucy: Oncall FYI — I’ll be available for rollback 10:00–11:00 window. What’s the rollback plan?

sara: Rollback plan in PR — quick summary: revert catalog pin, scale down new variant, re-route traffic to previous pinned version. Rollback target <5 min if we have the devops runbook steps.

kevin: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/catalog/pins/pull/452 — has the pin change + rolloutPolicy config. Please add +1s there.

marta: Quick checklist for my smoke tests:
- run eval set through canary endpoints
- compare 1k prompts for top-1 token overlap, inject similarity thresholds
- check embedding cosine distribution vs baseline
- confirm log-prob distributions not shifting heavily

sara: Adding the exact smoke commands (staging credentials set):
```bash
# run a quick generation smoke on canary
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "orbit-9b:v1.2.0-canary", "prompt": "Summarize the following...", "max_tokens": 64}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.choices[0].text'

# embeddings sanity (random sample)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "orbit-9b-embed:v1.2.0-canary", "input": ["test sentence 1","test sentence 2"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings | jq '.data'
```

ezra: Infra smoke list:
- confirm GPU usage < 85% on canary nodes
- tail runtime logs for OOM / nvtx warnings
- validate KV cache warmup within 10 requests
- kubectl rollout status for serving-deployment

kevin: I added rolloutPolicy in PR to allow automatic rollback if error-rate > 2% for 5m. If not comfortable, we can keep manual. Thoughts?

marta: Auto-rollback is fine as long as we have quick alerts to #eng-oncall and to the deploy channel.

sara: OK set auto-rollback trigger, but retention for alerts: send to #incidents + SMS for Lucy.

deploy-bot: [CI] pipeline catalog/pins#452 succeeded — image pushed to registry at digest sha256:abc123 

kevin: Can the team do a quick preflight at 09:40 PST (30m before) to validate preconditions? I’ll run a dry-run of the config apply in staging.

ezra: 09:40 works. I’ll also run a small staging canary at 09:50 to validate KV cache behavior.

marta: I’ll post eval results in this thread by 09:55.

sara: Great — final ask: when you sign off post-smoke, reply with ":shipit:" here and I’ll kick the pin + rollout.

kevin: Signed off for catalog config -> :shipit: (preflight dry-run green)

ezra: Infra preflight green, GPU temps normal, KV ready -> :shipit:

marta: Eval delta within tolerance (token overlap 0.95 vs baseline, embedding cosine mean diff 0.02) -> :shipit:

sara: Kicking canary at 10:00 now. I’ll post quick results.

sara: Canary note: initial latency 95th = 210ms, error-rate 0.1%, token cost within expected. Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/orbit-9b-canary

lucy: Watching metrics + pager on. If anything spikes ping me and I’ll trigger rollback.

kevin: After 20m canary looks clean. Proceeding to 50% at 10:20.

sara: Rolling to 50% now.

marta: 50% eval in progress — no regressions so far.

ezra: Autoscaler stable, node counts as expected.

kevin: Moving to 100% at 10:40.

sara: Full rollout complete 10:43. No rollback needed. Thanks team! :tada:

lucy: Noted — I’ll close the oncall window. All clear.

sara: Filed runbook notes + postmortem-lite: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/orbit-9b-rollout-1967890123

kevin: Thanks everyone.

marta: Nice work.
